title: The front door ships the unused DAWN branch's client code, so / sits at its 450 KB first-load cap and unrelated PRs fail the build

source.ref: Production e173a1f (2026-11-17) read the front door / at 450 KB of its 450 KB check:shell-weight budget; Dependabot #5138 (resend 6.38.1, Playwright 1.65.1, no browser code) failed that gate on its Vercel preview.

detail: MEASURED 2026-11-17 from production rkw7zm69n (commit e173a1f). The 12 chunks check:shell-weight counts for [project]/app/page add up to 460,767 bytes against 460,800, so 33 bytes were left. A local build of main reads 458,109; Vercel inlines about 2.7 KB more (analytics config, Sentry DSN and SHA, the Maps key, and about 2 KB not yet traced). CAUSE: SITE_DESIGN always resolves to frequency, so / renders SiteShell + FrequencyHome, but app/page.tsx still statically imported the DAWN branch's modules: lib/page-editor/config (every site-kit block, about 184 KB in one chunk), the Puck field pickers, MarketingHeader with its mega menu and the lib/nav/studio admin catalog, and MarketingFooter. A static import puts every 'use client' module those reach into the page's eager JS whether or not the branch renders. FIX: the DAWN branch loads those modules with import() inside the branch. The branch's source is unchanged, so check:render-path (home renders BlockRender), SCAN-802's schema probe and the MarketingHeader viewer test still read it. The Vercel preview's check:shell-weight line is the measurement. Further trims if ever needed: split lib/nav/studio's admin catalog out of lib/nav/registry, and keep editor-only field pickers out of block configs.

verify.cmd: node -e "const s=require('fs').readFileSync('app/page.tsx','utf8');const bad=[];for(const m of ['@/lib/page-editor/config','@/components/layout/marketing-header','@/components/layout/marketing-footer'])if(new RegExp('^import [^\\n]*from [\\x27\\x22]'+m.replace(/[/.]/g,'\\\\$&')+'[\\x27\\x22]','m').test(s))bad.push(m);if(!/import\\(\\x27@\\/lib\\/page-editor\\/config\\x27\\)/.test(s))bad.push('DAWN branch no longer loads config lazily');if(bad.length){console.error('PERF-004: static front-door import of '+bad.join(', '));process.exit(1)}console.log('PERF-004 ok')"
verify.note: The consequence is the Vercel build's check:shell-weight front-door line, which fails the deploy on its own. This probe keeps the cause from coming back: no top-level static import of the DAWN-only client modules in app/page.tsx.
